name: Soccer ball
headline: circumference
subtitle: Full-size match ball
description: A soccer ball is an air-filled sphere, usually made of stitched or bonded synthetic panels. Law 2 of the Laws of the Game, set by The IFAB, requires a circumference of 68 to 70 cm and a weight of 410 to 450 g at the start of a match. The law also limits its inflation pressure.

measures.label: Circumference
measures.note: Law 2.1: between 68 cm (27 in) and 70 cm (28 in)

measures.label: Weight
measures.note: Law 2.1: between 410 g (14 oz) and 450 g (16 oz) at the start of the match

facts.text: Law 2 requires a ball pressure of 0.6-1.1 atmosphere (600-1,100 g/cm2) at sea level.

sources.title: Laws of the Game, Law 2 - The Ball

caveats: The Law gives circumference, not diameter; any diameter shown is calculated from it.
